reborn-casters-pilot (RULES 16); no raw evidence at this size. A development study (RULES 14): descriptive, no claim
without a confirmation (RULES 8).

- no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in borg.txt (and the scary list lines in its list);
- every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; frozen-turn bursts classified and key outliers listed;
- death bundles reproduced.
Report per arm and per class, pooled over the tiers so far (RULES 14): deaths and causes, CL1-3 deaths, mean max CL

over the five comparisons (deaths, all four classes pooled); per class the same counts, descriptive. An unadjusted
p < 0.05 that does not survive Holm is a lead, not a result. Each arm is reported as harmful, neutral (safe to
adopt) or helpful (RULES 18), overall and per class; a per-class lead is a candidate for an @class line
(borg-reborn-rs#673).
